project.name: Tolong, Jangan Diblokir
project.description: AI-driven interactive text-based horror game - WhatsApp clone chat interface with Gemini API backend on Cloudflare Workers

root.backend/worker.js: Cloudflare Worker - Gemini API gateway with multi-chapter system prompts
root.tsconfig.app.json: App TypeScript config with @/* path alias

src/.index.css: WhatsApp Dark Mode CSS + GameMenu styling + mobile fixes
src/.vite-env.d.ts: Type declarations for CSS modules and import.meta.env
src/.hooks/useChat.ts: Game state, dynamic Nindi responses, ending logic, auto-scroll
src/.services/api.ts: API service layer for Cloudflare Worker endpoints
src/.components/game/GameMenu.tsx: Opening screen - title, name input, gender selection, Start/Settings/About/Exit
src/.components/whatsapp/WhatsAppContainer.ts: Main WhatsApp layout - header, chat area, input, ending screen
src/.components/whatsapp/WhatsAppHeader.tsx: Header - back arrow, Nindi avatar, name, status, call icons, menu
src/.components/whatsapp/ChatArea.tsx: Chat message list with date separators and typing indicator
src/.components/whatsapp/ChatBubble.tsx: Player (right, green) and Nindi (left, dark grey) message bubbles
src/.components/whatsapp/TypingIndicator.tsx: 'Nindi sedang mengetik...' animation with 3 pulsing dots
src/.components/whatsapp/MessageInput.tsx: Input field with emoji, attachment, camera, and send button

chapter_1.title: The Victim (Kisah Nindi)
chapter_1.premise: Nindi trapped in dark empty campus building. Player chats with her via WhatsApp-like interface. Initially wrong number, then she asks for help.

endings.description: Nindi escapes, will contact player in Chapter 2
Nindi disappears, entity uses her number
Entity fully controls Nindi, messages are not human anymore

chapter_2.title: The Observer (Kisah Dimas)
chapter_2.premise: New character Dimas (IT staff / night guard) chats with player. Depending on Chapter 1 ending, either Nindi contacts him or the entity uses Nindi's number.

environment_variables.GEMINI_API_KEY: Google AI Studio API key (set in Cloudflare dashboard, NOT in frontend)

setup_steps.1: Create GitHub repo and push this project
setup_steps.2: Connect Cloudflare Pages to GitHub repo (build command: npm install && npm run build, output dir: dist)
setup_steps.4: Add GEMINI_API_KEY to Cloudflare Pages environment variables
setup_steps.5: Update VITE_API_URL in src/services/api.ts with deployed Worker URL

mobile_input_fix.issue: Chat input not visible on mobile browsers
mobile_input_fix.solution: input-area uses position: sticky; bottom: 0; container uses height: 100dvh

notes: TypeScript compilation must pass before deploying to Cloudflare Pages
Vite v5 recommended (v8 has rolldown native binding issues on some Windows environments)
GEMINI_API_KEY must be set in Cloudflare dashboard, never in frontend code
Auto-deploy triggers on every git push to main branch
